reuse.why: Puts the check inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider link handler already delegates to, reusing its account lookup.

duplication.why: The upgrading-account lookup is hoisted rather than duplicated; no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The guard lives in the server accounts app next to the existing already-linked rule, before any bank creation or sync.

scope.why: Only reorders the lookup and adds the closed guard plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Single guard on the single linking path; small and easy to follow.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount, used by all provider link handlers
